newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat offers down, soy mixed.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - SRW wheat offers down, soy mixed.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soft red winter wheat basis offers edged lower Tuesday because of poor export demand, grain dealers said.
Hard red winter wheat basis values were mostly unchanged.
Old-crop soybean basis offers rose four cents per bushel to offset the drop in CBOT August soybean futures. Dealers said the cash soybean markets were quiet.
Corn basis values were mostly unchanged.
Recent export sales include 112,000 tonnes of 1997/98 U.S. corn and South Korea's state Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. No 1 soybeans.
